annotations.title: Has this company written down what it bought?

description: Use when the user asks whether a company has impaired a brand or an acquisition, is preparing to sell a brand to a strategic buyer, or wants to know how acquirers have valued past deals. Returns every fiscal year in which the company tagged a goodwill or intangible impairment in its 10-K XBRL, with the amount by line (goodwill, brands and trademarks, other intangibles) and each filing's citation. Refuses before you are charged if none is tagged. Safe to cite: its controls are checked first, it states its limits, and every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. If a control fails it refuses and you are not charged. This tool charges nothing: it validates the request and returns a payment_url, the price and instructions. Pay by POSTing to payment_url over MPP (HTTP 402, a Stripe shared payment token from your wallet). Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. To have a sound result considered for publication on cultmath.com, add publish: true and question (what you were asked) to the POST body, and credit_name to be credited; CULT+MATH reviews every submission first, and a published piece earns one free run.
